svg.title: A dropped stream and its subscription
svg.desc: Three lifelines: planner, test-runner and its task store. The planner opens SendStreamingMessage and receives four frames: the task in TASK_STATE_SUBMITTED, the working status, and two artifactUpdate chunks of test-log.txt. The planner then closes the connection. test-runner appends chunks 03 and 04 to the stored task while no stream is open, so no client sees them. The planner calls SubscribeToTask, test-runner reads the stored task, and the first frame is a Task snapshot whose test-log.txt already holds four parts. Frames 2 to 5 carry chunks 05 to 08, frame 6 the completed status, and the stream closes. A second SubscribeToTask on the finished task fails with -32004 UnsupportedOperationError.
